issue: खान पान को वैभव तुम बिन गुण दाता — no verb; तुम बिन read with the first half, गुण दाता as an address.
our reading: Without you, O giver of virtues, there is no splendour of food and drink.
alternatives: The splendour of food and drink comes from you; without you, who gives virtues?

issue: शुभ गुण सुन्दर मुक्ति क्षीर निधि जाता रत्न चतुर्दश ताको कोई नहीं पाता — other versions have शुभ गुण मन्दिर सुन्दर … तुम बिन कोई नहीं पाता; ours has मुक्ति and ताको ('its', the ocean's). जाता read as 'born' (जात). The words have no 'without you': the meaning supplies it from stanza 5 (तुम बिन, twice) and from the common version's तुम बिन in this place.
our reading: You are auspicious virtue, beauty and liberation, born of the ocean of milk. No one gains its fourteen jewels without you.
alternatives: … born of the ocean of milk; those fourteen jewels no one gains (ताको = them).
